Tools: {"tool":"read_source","arguments":{"source_id":"...","unit":"million USD"}}

{"tool":"calculate","arguments":{"expression":"current-previous","variables":{

{"final":{"value":"...","unit":"million USD","result_id":"tool:3"}} publishes the answer
